review:
Johnny Cash vs the outlaw chicken from Chicken Rush, on 15 lines with three kinds of wild.

VS symbols become expanding wilds with random multipliers, and when they're part of a win, the two characters fight it out in an animated duel – the bigger multiplier wins, up to 500x. It's silly and fun. Medium-high volatility, 5,000x max and 97% RTP. Free spins about once every 243 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
